description: Store a client-encrypted memory entry for an entity. Server never sees plaintext (PBKDF2/AES-256-GCM). Requires wallet signature. Returns JSON receipt. Compliance: GDPR Art. 5, 32. Cost $0.01 per call.

actor_did.description: Optional DID of the agent performing the write.

entity_type.description: Category of entity this memory belongs to.

source_tool.description: Tool that produced this memory, e.g. 'verify_biodiversity'.

wallet_signature.description: EIP-191 signature over the deterministic write message.

name: memory.write

outputSchema.description: Receipt for a stored encrypted memory entry.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the caller plaintext.

entity_id.description: Entity the memory was written for.

entry_id.description: UUID of the persisted memory_entries row.

ok.description: True when the tool completed without a validation error.

payment.description: Settlement receipt after x402 or sandbox payment.

tool.description: Tool name that produced this payload.

title: Memory Write
